title: PHPantom Configuration
description: User configuration schema for .phpantom.toml: per-project settings for the PHPantom PHP language server.

version.description: Override the detected PHP version (e.g. "8.3"). When unset, PHPantom infers from composer.json's platform or require.php.

proxies.description: Generated transparent-proxy discovery rules. Matching subclasses keep their PHP type, while project metadata is attributed to their real parent class.

paths.description: Workspace-relative PHP files, directories, or glob patterns to scan for generated proxy subclasses.

marker-interface.description: Fully-qualified interface that a generated subclass must directly implement to be treated as a transparent proxy.

unresolved-member-access.description: Report member access (->, ?->, ::) on subjects whose type could not be resolved. Useful for discovering gaps in type coverage but produces too many diagnostics on codebases without comprehensive type annotations.

extra-arguments.description: Report calls that pass more arguments than the function accepts. PHP silently ignores extra arguments to user-defined functions, and many libraries exploit this for flexible APIs.

report-magic-properties.description: Report unknown property access on classes with __get when virtual properties are defined (via @property docblock tags, Laravel Eloquent column inference, or other providers). Matches PHPStan's reportMagicProperties behaviour.

downgrade-nullable-argument-mismatch.description: Downgrade type_mismatch_argument to a warning when the only reason an argument's type fails to satisfy the parameter is a stray null (every non-null member of the argument's type is already compatible).

workspace.description: Compute diagnostics for the whole workspace in the background after startup and the full index finish, so project-wide problems appear for files that are not open in the editor. Off by default: it costs a project-wide sweep every session. Requires the default "full" indexing strategy.

workspace-external.description: Run configured external tools (PHPStan, PHPCS, Mago) once over the whole project after workspace diagnostics finish. Only takes effect when "workspace" is enabled. Each tool only runs when it is enabled and has its own project-level configuration file (phpstan.neon, phpcs.xml, mago.toml).

ignore.description: Rules that suppress matching diagnostics, similar to PHPStan's ignoreErrors. Each rule may constrain by message (regex), path (glob relative to workspace root), and/or identifier (diagnostic code). A diagnostic is suppressed when it matches every constraint present on a rule; omitted constraints match anything.

items.description: A single ignore rule. At least one constraint (message, path, or identifier) must be present.

message.description: Regex matched against the diagnostic message.

path.description: Glob matched against the file path relative to the workspace root. Follows gitignore-style glob syntax: * does not cross /, use ** to match across directories.

indexing.description: Controls how PHPantom discovers classes across the workspace.

strategy.description: The indexing strategy for class discovery. "full" (default): scan PHP files, then background-parse user files to populate symbol and reference indexes. "composer": use Composer's classmap, fall back to self-scan. "self": scan all PHP files, ignore classmap. "none": no proactive scanning, classmap only.

exclude.description: Paths the workspace scanners skip, in gitignore syntax relative to the workspace root: a bare name matches at any depth, a pattern containing / anchors to the root, a trailing / restricts to directories, and a leading ! re-includes. Applies to background discovery and to the directories analyze walks. A file you open in the editor, or name outright on the analyze command line, is always served.

extensions.description: Extra file extensions (without the dot) treated as PHP source during workspace discovery, e.g. ["module", "inc", "theme"] for Drupal. .php is always included.

mode.description: Semantic token emission mode. "contextual" emits only context-sensitive tokens that complement editor syntax highlighting. "full" emits the complete semantic token stream. "off" disables semantic tokens.

schema.description: Controls Laravel database schema dump scanning for Eloquent model property inference.

enabled.description: Enable Laravel schema dump scanning. When enabled, PHPantom scans database/schema by default.

paths.description: Schema dump files or directories to scan, relative to the workspace root unless absolute. Defaults to ["database/schema"].

migrations.description: Controls Laravel migration scanning for Eloquent model property inference.

enabled.description: Enable Laravel migration scanning. When enabled, PHPantom scans direct PHP files in non-vendor database/migrations directories by default.

paths.description: Migration files or directories to scan, relative to the workspace root unless absolute. Direct PHP files in directories are scanned; subdirectories are not scanned.

symfony.description: Symfony runtime metadata recovered statically from compiled containers and configured PHP attributes.

container.description: Controls static compiled-container discovery. Container PHP is read as text and is never executed.

environment.description: Cache environment used by automatic var/cache/<environment> discovery.

paths.description: Optional workspace-relative compiled-container files, directories, or glob patterns. The newest useful match wins.

events.description: Configures event-name matching and attribute adapters. Exact listener wiring comes from the compiled container.

ignored-prefixes.description: Prefixes removed before event names are compared.

ignored-suffixes.description: Suffixes removed before event names are compared.

publishers.description: Rules that derive Symfony event publishers from PHP method attributes.

name-argument.description: Named argument containing an explicit event name.

name-position.description: Zero-based positional fallback for the explicit event-name argument.

dispatch-argument.description: Named argument containing dispatch enum cases.

dispatch-position.description: Zero-based positional fallback for the dispatch argument.

default-dispatch.description: Dispatch names used when the attribute omits its dispatch argument.

dispatch-cases.description: Map from PHP enum case name to the event-name dispatch segment.

explicit-name-template.description: Template used for explicit names. Supports the same placeholders plus {name}.

default-methods.description: Method names that omit the method suffix.

skip.description: Conditions that omit one derived dispatch when another attribute argument is set.

subscribers.description: Optional rules that expose event names written in subscriber method attributes before or without a compiled container.

transport-cases.description: Map from PHP enum case name to an event-name suffix.

expression-language.description: Maps configured PHP attribute and constructor arguments to Symfony ExpressionLanguage strings and their PHP type contracts.

attributes.description: Method-attribute arguments that contain an expression string or an array of expression strings.

position.description: Zero-based positional fallback for the expression argument.

method-parameters.description: Bind expression roots to method parameters with the same name.

bindings.description: Map expression roots to return, parameter:<name-or-index>, or class:<FQN> type sources.

constructors.description: Expression object constructors nested inside PHP method attributes.

argument.description: Named constructor argument containing the expression.

position.description: Zero-based positional fallback for the constructor argument.

inside-attribute-prefixes.description: Only match constructors nested in attributes whose FQN starts with one of these prefixes. An empty list matches any attribute.

method-parameters.description: Bind expression roots to method parameters with the same name.

bindings.description: Map expression roots to return, parameter:<name-or-index>, or class:<FQN> type sources.

formatting.description: Controls the formatting strategy. PHPantom ships a built-in formatter (PER-CS 2.0 style). Projects with php-cs-fixer or PHP_CodeSniffer in composer.json require-dev automatically use those tools instead. Explicit configuration here always takes priority.

pint.description: Command or path to run Laravel Pint. Unset: auto-detect from composer.json require-dev. Empty string: disable Pint. Any other value: use as the command.

php-cs-fixer.description: Command or path to run php-cs-fixer. Unset: auto-detect from composer.json require-dev. Empty string: disable php-cs-fixer. Any other value: use as the command.

phpcbf.description: Command or path to run phpcbf. Unset: auto-detect from composer.json require-dev. Empty string: disable phpcbf. Any other value: use as the command.

timeout.description: Maximum runtime in milliseconds per external formatting tool before it is killed. Applied per tool, not for the combined pipeline.

phpstan.description: PHPStan proxy settings. PHPantom can run PHPStan in editor mode on each file save and surface its errors as LSP diagnostics.

command.description: Command or path to run PHPStan. Unset: auto-detect via vendor/bin/phpstan then $PATH. Empty string: disable PHPStan integration. Any other value: use as the command.

memory-limit.description: Memory limit passed to PHPStan via --memory-limit.

timeout.description: Maximum runtime in milliseconds before PHPStan is killed.

phpcs.description: PHP_CodeSniffer proxy settings. PHPantom can run PHPCS on each file save and surface its findings as LSP diagnostics.

command.description: Command or path to run PHPCS. Unset: auto-detect via vendor/bin/phpcs then $PATH. Empty string: disable PHPCS integration. Any other value: use as the command.

standard.description: Coding standard to enforce (e.g. "PSR12"). Unset: PHPCS uses its own default detection (phpcs.xml / phpcs.xml.dist in the project root, then its built-in default).

timeout.description: Maximum runtime in milliseconds before PHPCS is killed.

mago.description: Mago proxy settings. Mago is only activated when mago.toml exists at the workspace root. PHPantom can run mago lint and mago analyze on each file save and surface their findings as LSP diagnostics.

command.description: Command or path to run Mago. Unset: auto-detect via vendor/bin/mago then $PATH. Empty string: disable Mago integration. Any other value: use as the command.

lint.description: Proxy mago lint diagnostics. Unset: only when mago.toml has a [linter] table.

analyze.description: Proxy mago analyze diagnostics. Unset: only when mago.toml has an [analyzer] table, and on a Laravel project only when it also wires up an extension, since Mago's analyser cannot otherwise see through Eloquent or the facades.

lint-timeout.description: Maximum runtime in milliseconds before mago lint is killed.

analyze-timeout.description: Maximum runtime in milliseconds before mago analyze is killed.
